name: MOTORIZED SIEVE SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-MSS-65 Motorized Sieve Shaker (Gyratory) is a heavy-duty, floor-mounted grading unit used primarily in mining, metallurgy, and industrial quality control labs. It is designed to impart a steady circular and tapping motion, ensuring reliable and rapid segregation of heavy, granular batch samples.
features: Imparts a smooth Gyratory (circular and tapping) mechanical motion
Rugged heavy gauge mild steel construction mounted on a cast iron base
Can hold up to 6 test sieves mounted securely on helical springs
Driven by a robust ¼ HP geared motor mechanism
Integrated mechanical timer (up to 60 mins) and vibration speed regulator

specifications.Housing Material: Heavy gauge mild steel powder coated on cast iron base
specifications.Test Sieves Supported: 8 x 2 inch OR 12 x 2 inch (Dia. x Height)
specifications.Timer: Mechanical timer up to 60 minutes (Digital optional)
specifications.Target Applications: Segregation of heavy granular materials in Mining & Metallurgy
specifications.Optional Upgrades: Brass or SS test sieves with Lid & Pan, Digital Timer
